tools.name: url_clean_content

tools.name: email_validator_basic
tools.description: Validate email syntax, domain and MX records for basic automated checks without SMTP mailbox verification.

tools.name: search_read
tools.description: Search the live web and retrieve clean readable content from relevant pages in one paid request.

tools.name: research_answer
tools.description: Answer a question using current web research by synthesizing evidence from multiple sources with cited URLs.

tools.name: web_intelligence
tools.description: Investigate a topic and produce machine-readable web intelligence: facts, evidence, confidence, agreements, conflicts and source URLs.

tools.name: chain_contract_call
tools.description: Execute a read-only EVM smart contract call on Ethereum or Base and return the normalized result without managing an RPC provider.

tools.name: transaction_intelligence
tools.description: Retrieve a Base or Ethereum transaction and receipt in one paid request, with deterministic execution status, transaction classification, method selector, gas cost, logs count and raw RPC evidence.

tools.name: search_extract
tools.description: Search the live web and extract requested structured fields from relevant pages in one request.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Search multiple live web sources and return structured factual claims with supporting evidence and source URLs.

tools.name: dns_intelligence
tools.description: Inspect DNS records, mail configuration, SPF and DMARC for a public domain in one request.

tools.name: domain_health
tools.description: Check public domain DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, redirects, TLS certificate health and response latency in one request.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_evidence · Private data: email_validator_basic, dns_intelligence · Public sink: email_validator_basic · Destructive: chain_contract_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_evidence · Private data: email_validator_basic, dns_intelligence · Public sink: email_validator_basic · Destructive: chain_contract_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

→ after: "Search, read, extract, verify with evidence, research, compare or detect web changes in one paid machine-to-machine product without orchestrating multiple web APIs."
remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
